item.title: Full professor: Selection procedure by call for Full professors (professori di I fascia). 2026_PRO_DASTU_1 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-21 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milano
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-09 Progettazione architettonica

The candidate will carry out research activities within the SSD CEAR-09/A Architectural and Urban Design, focusing on theoretical, methodological, and design aspects; the analysis of typological, morphological, and linguistic characteristics of architecture and the city; as well as compositional and design aspects in urban, extra-urban, and infrastructure contexts, with reference to the design of new interventions and the transformation of the existing heritage.
